- [EVENT] User is thinking of getting a new phone with more storage capacity.
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in the pros and cons of 128GB vs 256GB phones.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 128GB Phone Pros: Cost-effective, sufficient storage for most users, faster performance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 128GB Phone Cons: Limited storage for heavy users, less room for future growth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 256GB Phone Pros: Ample storage for heavy users, future-proofing, peace of mind.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 256GB Phone Cons: Higher cost, potential for slower performance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendation: If casual user, 128GB might be sufficient; if heavy user, 256GB is likely better.
